ov: حكاية لعبة (الإنجليزية: Toy Story) هو فلم رسوم متحركة من تصميم شركة بيكسار ومن إنتاج شركة والت ديزني عام 1995.ويعتبر فلم حكاية لعبة (Toy Story) أول فلم متكامل صنع بأكمله باستخدام الحاسوب. يحكى الفلم عن أندي الطفل الصغير الذي يملك العديد من اللعب وهي: وودي اللعبة راعي البقر المفضلة لديه، وبو راعية الغنم، وأستاذ بطاطس اللعبة التي تفقد معظم أجزائها وركس الديناصور الأخضر، وسلنكي الكلب وهام الخنزير الحصالة.
plotEn:
In a world where toys are sentient but pretend to be lifeless around humans, a group of toys, led by Sheriff Woody, are preparing to move to a new house with their young owner, Andy Davis, and his family. During the party for Andy's sixth birthday, the toys become concerned that Andy might receive a new toy that will replace them. Andy receives a Buzz Lightyear action figure, who believes that he is an actual Space Ranger and does not know that he is a toy. Buzz impresses the others with his electronic features and becomes Andy's new favorite toy, much to Woody's jealousy.
Two days before the move, Andy's family plans to have dinner at Pizza Planet, and Andy is allowed to bring one toy along. To ensure Andy brings him instead of Buzz, Woody attempts to trap Buzz behind Andy's desk, but accidentally knocks him out the window instead. Believing Woody pushed Buzz on purpose, the other toys rebel against Woody until Andy takes him into the car, with Buzz following. When the car stops at a gas station, Buzz furiously confronts Woody. The two fight, fall out of the car, and are left behind, but then manage to hitch a ride on a Pizza Planet delivery truck. At Pizza Planet, Buzz mistakes a claw machine for a rocket and climbs in, pursued by Woody. Sid Phillips, Andy's sadistic next-door neighbor, grabs Woody and Buzz with the claw and takes them to his house, where they encounter his mutant toys, made from parts of toys Sid has destroyed.
